Setting.EnableLoggingHint: Enable diagnostic console logs for this browser.

UI.StatusHint: Last reports from this GM session, not proof of audibility. Other GMs and previous sessions may be unknown. Tabs report separately. Offline commands are not replayed.

UI.SortHint: Use the arrow buttons to reorder entries.

UI.LiveHint: Release to send to these recipients, regardless of the sound selected above. Stop ends their module sound. Presets are unchanged.
UI.NoPlaybackReport: Sound unknown: no report in this session
UI.RecipientHint: Select the recipients for Play, Volume and Stop. Selecting or clearing recipients does not start or stop audio.
